notes: No seed website in the SOS list; one web search found www.childresstx.us. No Clarity or vendor site found. Files are Rails active_storage blobs served from the county host; Last-Modified values differ per file and match plausible upload dates. The precinct PDF is a scan (no text layer); its content was identified by page title and file name 'PCT X PCT PART 1/2'. The runoff NONE rests on absence of any results file on both runoff pages; results could have been posted elsewhere and removed. 2024 general undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_runoff NONE to UNDETERMINED.
tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. Exactly one election is determined, so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: The county home page lists election pages only from Nov 2025 onward; no 2024 general results are posted. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Republican Primary 2026 results' is the 'Texas Secretary of State Election Unofficial Results Report 2026 REPUBLICAN PRIMARY ELECTION March 03, 2026 CHILDRESS County' (county totals only), PDF CreationDate 2026-03-04 06:09:10 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 18:43:13 GMT (12:43 PM CST Mar 4). Precinct numbers appear only in 'Precinct by Precinct Results of March Primaries' ('PCT X PCT PART 1.pdf', CreationDate 2026-04-02, Last-Modified Tue, 14 Apr 2026 05:35:01 GMT).

2026_runoff.fact: Rule 43: the county pages do not point this election's results to the SOS site, so NONE lacks positive evidence. Previous: The 'May 2026 Republican Runoff Election' page lists only 'Notice of Runoff Primary Election', 'Notice of Precinct Consolidations' and 'Precinct Consolidation Approval Form'; the 'May 2026 Democratic Primary Runoff Election' page lists only notices and consolidation forms. The home page links no runoff results page.
